title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY):

items: Launched on May 9, 2015, is a one-year life insurance scheme offering Rs. 2 lakh coverage in case
of death (normal, accidental, or due to Covid-19).
o Eligibility: Individuals aged 18-50 years with a bank account.
o Premium: Rs. 436 per year (auto-debited from bank account).
o Coverage Period: From June 1 to May 31 (renewable annually).
o Claim: Payable to the nominee in case of death.
o Administered by: LIC and other insurers.
o Exclusions: No coverage for death by suicide within the first year.
